snippet.title: Mops & Mobs Teaser June 2025
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2851050/Mops__Mobs_A_Sweeping_Dungeon_Novel
Play our new demo - now with card battles!

Welcome to your new job! As the dungeon's janitor, you take care of our monsters' well-being, pick up adventurers' left-over limbs, and find ways to let our beloved Dungeon Master look more competent. 

Music by @MCTannhaeuser 

More from the project: https://mopsmobs.ratking.de
Blog: https://ratking.de/blog
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ratkinggames
TikTok: www.tiktok.com/@ratkingentertainment
